title: baccharis tola var. incarum
intro: Baccharis tola var. incarum, commonly known as Bolivian tree cineraria, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. The health benefits of Baccharis tola var. incarum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Baccharis tola var. incarum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
